title: AI-powered drug discovery
text: Super exciting start-up!  This concept of AI start-ups with domain expertise in a specific area (i.e. drug development in this case) contracting their services to industry leaders (i.e. big pharma dinosaurs) seems to a logical approach. The general purpose LLMs are great for the public, but specific industry expertise and applications will be critical.
